summary:
Click-everything sweep focused on the two known regression bugs (LP print family leak + Print '_lang is not defined' ReferenceError) plus core surfaces (Login, Dashboard/HomePicker, Siding Editor 5d7b7f67 tabs, LP Editor c09d9ac1 tab, HoverImportButton restore modal open→warnings-toggle→print→cancel) in BOTH EN and ES. All highest-priority regression targets PASS. window.open/document.open/write/close/print were stubbed via context init script so print popups were captured and inspected in-memory (no browser popups needed). Real HTML output was pulled from the fake popup buffer and asserted for family scoping.

CORE MATRIX (surface × button × EN/ES):
- Login /login: language-toggle present [EN PASS, ES PASS]; bad-password shows auth-error 'Invalid email or password' (not blank/crash) [EN PASS, ES PASS]; valid login → landed at / [EN PASS].
- HomePicker / (root after login): renders workspace picker (ISS + Contractor cards); nav testids present (nav-estimates, nav-catalog, nav-team, lang-toggle, logout-btn); lang-toggle EN/ES buttons render; ES header shows 'ESTIMADOR/ESTIMADOS/CATÁLOGO/EQUIPO/DUEÑO' [EN PASS, ES PASS]. Note: the '/' route hits HomePicker (not Dashboard) — the previous iteration's Dashboard testid check reported FAIL but that is a false alarm: the app was intentionally showing HomePicker so the user can pick ISS vs Contractor family. Dashboard proper is reached AFTER picking a family; not walked in this sweep (see SKIPPED).
- Siding Editor /estimate/5d7b7f67-c110-4c96-9580-e51db5452e67 (EST-853809 '3 degree vinyl 8-2-26 5am'): editor-loads [EN PASS, ES PASS]; tabs discovered = 2 (estimator-tab-vinyl, estimator-tab-ascend); click-tab-vinyl [EN PASS, ES PASS]; click-tab-ascend [EN PASS, ES PASS]; console-clean (no ReferenceError/TypeError from clicks) [EN PASS, ES PASS].
- Siding Hover Restore Modal (hover-restore-btn on siding estimate): modal opens [EN PASS, ES PASS]; hover-warnings-toggle click [EN PASS, ES PASS]; hover-openings-toggle NOT PRESENT on this estimate's cached HOVER run (this fixture has no window-opening rows so section is not rendered — SKIPPED, expected); PRINT (hover-print-btn) generates HTML popup [EN PASS, ES PASS] with htmlLen≈32.8KB containing vinyl-section=True, ascend-section=True, lp-section=False — FAMILY SCOPING CORRECT (siding-only, no LP SMARTSIDE leak); no '_lang is not defined' ReferenceError anywhere [EN PASS, ES PASS]; no other ReferenceError [EN PASS, ES PASS]; hover-cancel-btn closes modal [EN PASS, ES PASS]. Did NOT click hover-apply-btn (SAFETY per instructions — demo fixture).
- LP Editor /estimate/c09d9ac1-0d88-4ce8-b032-1f4db0d2257c (EST-536665 '3 degree rd 8-4-26 4pm'): editor-loads [EN PASS, ES PASS]; tabs discovered = 1 (estimator-tab-lp_smart); click-tab-lp_smart [EN PASS, ES PASS]; console-clean [EN PASS, ES PASS].
- LP Hover Restore Modal PRINT (regression-check for the just-fixed vinyl-section-in-LP-printout bug): modal opens [EN PASS, ES PASS]; PRINT HTML htmlLen≈18.8KB contains lp-section=True, vinyl-section=False, ascend-section=False — FAMILY SCOPING CORRECT (LP-only, no cross-family leak) [EN PASS, ES PASS]; no '_lang is not defined' [EN PASS, ES PASS]; no ReferenceError [EN PASS, ES PASS]; cancel closes modal [EN PASS, ES PASS].

REGRESSION VERDICT: Both the '_lang is not defined' Print ReferenceError AND the LP-printout-showing-vinyl cross-family leak are CONFIRMED FIXED in both languages on both estimate kinds. printTakeoff.js scopePrintLines guard is holding. No new click-only crashes surfaced on the surfaces walked.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Print popups can be captured by injecting an init script that stubs window.open to return an object whose document.open/write/writeln/close append into a chunks[] buffer exposed via `w.__html`. The full stub used this iteration is in the script logs — reuse it. window.print is a no-op. The stub is required because the real printTakeoff calls w.document.open() which is missing on a naive stub object and would raise 'w.document.open is not a function' as a false-positive pageerror.

Data observed:
- Siding print HTML on EST-853809 ≈ 32.8KB, contains 'Vinyl'/'Ascend' section headers, does NOT contain 'LP SMARTSIDE'.
- LP print HTML on EST-536665 ≈ 18.8KB, contains 'LP SMARTSIDE' section, does NOT contain 'Vinyl' or 'Ascend'.
- Both HTML docs have <html lang="en"> even in ES locale — the <html lang> attribute may not be honoring ui-lang-v1 (minor; content strings inside ARE translated where translations exist).
- Neither cached HOVER run on the two walked estimates has openings rows, so hover-openings-toggle branch of the modal was not exercisable.

Next iteration TODO: create a sandbox estimate (POST /api/estimates), then walk QuoteModal (data-testid on send-lang-picker/send-lang-en/send-lang-es exists in QuoteModal.jsx line 284+), EmailModal, and use a printed 'window.print' page (rather than window.open) if any surface uses it.
rca of the issue: N/A — both prior regression bugs are fixed. RCA on prior fixes: (1) '_lang is not defined' was a scope leak in printTakeoff.js where a helper closed over `_lang` without declaring it; fix is holding — no ReferenceError on 4/4 print clicks (EN+ES × siding+LP). (2) LP printout showing VINYL SIDING section was a missing family filter in scopePrintLines; fix is holding — LP print HTML has zero vinyl/ascend markers, siding print HTML has zero LP markers, on both languages.
